title: ServerConfig
description:
Process configuration (listen addresses, data directory, bootstrap). Source of truth for `docs/src/generated/server-config.md`.

After first start, ingest token, series retention, and scrape jobs are stored in the Settings UI (SQLite). TOML values seed that row once. `KEYSTONE_INGEST_TOKEN` always overrides the stored token. Listen addresses, `data_dir`, and auth username stay in this file.

data_dir.description: Data directory for SQLite, sessions, and the series store.

http_listen.description: HTTP UI and API listen address.

ingest_token.description: Bootstrap ingest token. Copied into Settings on first start. After that, change it in the UI. `KEYSTONE_INGEST_TOKEN` always wins.

prometheus_scrape.description: Bootstrap Prometheus scrape jobs. Copied into Settings on first start.

retention_hours.description: Bootstrap series retention in hours (default 24). Copied into Settings on first start; change it in the UI afterwards.

snmp_scrape.description: Bootstrap SNMP scrape jobs. Copied into Settings on first start.

name.description: Job name stored as the node_id if `node_id` is empty.

node_id.description: Optional node id to attach samples to.

password_hash.description: Argon2id password hash. If empty, `KEYSTONE_ADMIN_PASSWORD` is hashed on first start.
